box.estimate: P1 ~2.5 h (three 600-step arms at ~1.9 s/step plus load and val scoring, plus two footprint sweeps); P2 ~1.5 h plus the download. ~4 h = ~$9.2.
box.auto_terminate: The queue stops all GPU work at the wall-clock cap or the box ceiling and writes BOX_CEILING; the instance is terminated by the human (no agent holds a cloud credential). The box guard of HANDOFF/next-training-plan-2026-10-06.md precaution 4 must be in the queue before launch.

P1.what: Recipe parity on the 2B tower. One seed (0), v5's data and recipe flags (the v5 ft row's recipe) except --optimizer, --max-steps 600 (past bf16's 384-step freeze, so the schedule is one plain bf16 could not pass), --score-val after each arm. Then tools/gh200_footprint.py --optimizer master and --optimizer kahan.

arms.master-repeat: --optimizer master, the same seed and data order: the run-to-run noise floor on this device

P1.per_arm: the per-step letter and span channel losses (QwenDecisionStep.letter_log / span_log, in the checkpoint), val choice top-1 and span top-1 from --score-val, the optimizer step time (median of steps 101-600) and the peak memory from gh200_footprint.py at the arm's recipe.

definitions.loss_gap(a,b): mean over steps 385-600 of |letter_a - letter_b| / letter_b
definitions.val_gap(a,b): val choice top-1 of a minus that of b, with a paired bootstrap 95% interval over val rows (2,000 draws, seed 20261006)

outcomes.admissible: loss_gap(kahan, master) <= max(2 x floor, 0.02), and val_gap(kahan, master)'s interval lies inside [-0.02, +0.02], and kahan's measured peak <= 0.80 x master's at the same shape, and kahan's median step time <= 1.5 x master's.
outcomes.slow: every condition of 'admissible' but the step time. kahan is not used until its step moves to torch._foreach_* slices and P1's timing is re-run.
outcomes.diverges: loss_gap(kahan, master) > max(2 x floor, 0.02), or val_gap's interval leaves [-0.02, +0.02].
outcomes.no_saving: kahan's measured peak > 0.80 x master's: the 14 vs 20 B/param arithmetic does not survive the allocator.
outcomes.refused: any arm did not complete, or a check could not run. Never read as any other word.

P2.runs_only_if: P1 reads 'admissible', and the human said yes to the 4B download
P2.what: The 4B base: tools/memory_budget.py --snapshot <4B> (the measured parameter count, against the derived 4,205,751,296), then tools/gh200_rows.py --snapshot <4B> --optimizer kahan --width 9638 --loss fused-ce, walking rows up until the device refuses. --loss fused-ce drives the trainer's own loss head, which every earlier GH200 measurement left out (GAP-LOSS-HEAD-TERM-NEVER-MEASURED-2026-10-06). The row count a later 4B run launches at is this measured one, not the predicted 38,552 tokens. Before any GPU work, spec_from_checkpoint and load_text_tower check the download's shape and head tie; a refusal there is recorded as a finding about the download, and no check is relaxed to proceed.
P2.not_a_training_run: No 4B ft row is written by P2.
